# MergeAggregateNode

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.Nodes.MergeAggregateNode`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`

## Summary

Merges partial aggregate results from parallel partitions. Handles COUNT (sum), SUM (sum), AVG (weighted), MIN, MAX. NOTE: COUNT(DISTINCT) cannot be parallel-partitioned because summing partial distinct counts would double-count values that appear in multiple partitions. COUNT(DISTINCT) must be handled by a single aggregate query or a different strategy (e.g., client-side DISTINCT followed by COUNT).
